Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

sea — the salt water near the coast. Example: The sea is in the south.
mountain — a very high hill. Example: There is a high mountain near the village.
tree — a tall plant with a trunk. Example: I plant a tree every year.
flower — the coloured part of a plant. Example: There are many flowers in the forest.
animal — a living creature, like a dog. Example: Don't feed the animals.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There is a high mountain.
• There are many trees.
• The sea is near ...
• It is a beautiful landscape.
• There are animals in the forest.
